original_ai_output.title_zh: 分析：改革埃塞俄比亚民族联邦制以推进和平与安全
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 一篇分析文章指出，埃塞俄比亚的民族联邦模式构成结构性不稳定来源，地区民兵持续与联邦政府对抗。文章称，2026年9月提格雷人民解放阵线及其盟友发动袭击，引发对重回2020-2022年冲突的担忧；自2024年以来，相关战斗年均约1500起冲突、约4900人死亡。文章认为，改革该模式需同时开放政治空间并推进解除武装。

key_facts.fact: 文章称提格雷人民解放阵线及其盟友于2026年9月对联邦政府发动袭击
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Attacks launched by the Tigray People’s Liberation Front (TPLF) and its allies against the federal government in September 2026 raised fears of a return to the destructive conflict of 2020-2022

key_facts.fact: 文章称2020-2022年冲突估计造成60万人死亡
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the destructive conflict of 2020-2022, in which an estimated 600,000 people perished

key_facts.fact: 文章称自2024年以来相关战斗年均约1500起冲突、约4900人死亡
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Fighting involving these groups and federal forces has resulted in an average of 1,500 clashes and 4,900 battle-related fatalities annually since 2024

key_facts.fact: 文章称约90%的死亡与阿姆哈拉法诺民族运动和奥罗莫解放军有关
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Roughly 90 percent of these fatalities are linked to two groups: the Amhara Fano National Movement (60 percent) and the Oromo Liberation Army (30 percent)

key_facts.fact: 文章称埃塞俄比亚民族联邦模式建立于1995年，赋予地区分离权并授权地区警察力量
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Established by the TPLF-led federal government in 1995, the model created ethnically based jurisdictions and gave regions the right to secede. The constitution also authorized regional police forces

uncertainties: 文章为分析评论，所引冲突与伤亡数字为估计值，未获独立核实
提格雷人民解放阵线方面对相关指控的说法未在文中呈现
